reviews.title: Great for its size!
reviews.comment: This is an excellent mass-storage device. FYI- It had to be hooked directly to the motherboard. My server bay maxes out at 16tb. But it works well and has given no hiccups or slowdowns on my server.
reviews.author: LAWJR3

reviews.comment: DOA, Clicking noise.  Installed a few days outside of return window, bummer.

reviews.title: Fastest mechanical drive
reviews.comment: Works great and performance is as expected.  Replaced my four-year-old 18tb Exos drive for this bigger drive.  The only reason the drive was replaced was for more storage. The temps are excellent as  long as you have airflow in your case.
reviews.author: DOH

reviews.title: Good, no issue
reviews.comment: Bought it for a NAS. Use for few months now and didn't see any issues so far.
reviews.author: Cris

reviews.title: Dependable
reviews.comment: I bought a total of 4 to date, and plan to buy another 2. I have a long history with Seagate drives and don't really trust any other brand. I have never had a Seagate drive fail on me, and THE ones that did over the decades were *all* from a particular other brand. That can't be a coincidence... Seagate drives are just more reliable.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
